command: pre-registration of plan D2's read g30_rl

metrics.acceptance: as E3: 10 episodes on stored init states 0-9 at seed 13; the arm is kept where it beats the frozen policy there, else the policy serves

hypotheses.H1: E3's library with acceptance is non-inferior to pi_RL (LoRA, matched budget, lora@pirlm) with acceptance on the G3/G4 subset (margin 0.05: lower bound of the task-level difference > -0.05)
hypotheses.descriptive: pi_RL at 100 practice episodes (lora@pirl) with acceptance against the library, the per-task LoRA with acceptance and DSRL on the per-task LoRA (G7 dsrls, 100 practice episodes) with acceptance; each pi_RL arm against its own initialisation (the per-task LoRA) and against zero-shot; practice successes (first 10 / last 20 episodes); environment steps, chunks, PPO updates and A40-hours of each arm; storage (the served LoRA, 18.8 MB, as the per-task LoRA)

metrics.parity: RLinf-Pi05-LIBERO-SFT on LIBERO-Spatial in RLinf's harness: 0.79 success (100 trajectories, job 4171082) against the published 84.6, recorded before this pre-registration; the PPO checkpoints' parity runs alongside
metrics.protocol: the G3/G4 tasks of E3 (9, 10, 12, 13, 14, 15, 30; 25, 31, 36, 41, 43, 55, 56, 57, 58, 59, 61, 62, 71), E3's fresh set b (sampler seeds 200000-200019), 20 episodes per task, noise seed 13, paired with E3's arms (library with acceptance, per-task LoRA with acceptance, zero-shot) and G7's dsrls; exact sign test on discordant pairs, two-level bootstrap over tasks and episodes (experiments/e1_read.py compare); RL practice on stored init states 0-29 only (STATE_MOD 30), never set b

recipe.critic: ValueHead 2048-1024-512-256-1 on the masked mean of the VLM prefix output (value_after_vlm)
recipe.logprob: joint over the chain (mean over K+1 steps), executed 5 actions x 7 dims summed
recipe.noise: Flow-Noise: ExploreNoiseNet on the expert's final hidden state, sigma in RLinf's [0.08, 0.16] scaled by sqrt(3/10) for 10 Euler steps (RLinf's pi0.5 LIBERO PPO uses 3)
recipe.ppo: GAE 0.99 / 0.95, normalised advantages, clip 0.2, dual clip 3.0, value clip 0.2, Adam (0.9, 0.95), grad clip 1.0, actor lr 2e-5 (LoRA + noise head), value lr 1e-4, one epoch per 4-episode batch, minibatch 16 chunks
recipe.test: deterministic ODE through the trained LoRA (noise head off), 10 steps, as every adapter arm

metrics.written_before: any G30e training episode or read episode
